about.title: Multtiplus Technologies
about.body:
Founded in July 2017, Multtiplus Technologies operates as an integrator specialized in the development of Information Technology projects focused on business management solutions. Throughout its journey, the company has consolidated expertise in serving both the private and public sectors, applying IT governance, performance metrics and agile practices to ensure operational efficiency, process transparency and delivery traceability.

Multtiplus stands out through an approach centered on collaboration and the development of strategic product and service partnerships. Each project is handled in a personalized way, considering regulatory requirements, compliance needs and each client’s specific business objectives — from the private sector to government. In this way, Multtiplus transforms technology challenges into robust, scalable solutions with tangible value, while preserving adaptability and alignment with each client’s business and purpose.
